cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. These eighty wedding place cards need names. Your bin labels have better lettering than our invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like calligraphy. I hate copying guest lists.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I'd read the names. You'd only do the beautiful part.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your aunt will complain if I use purple.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle my aunt. The ink colour could be entirely yours.

mechanism: A uses exacting calligraphy coaching to make repetitive place-card labour feel like a chance at skilled work, removing B obstacles while keeping the expert role.
confusable: S02 would simply bargain for cooperation; S03 must keep correcting standards as the means of making the task attractive.
comparison: Shed alternative offers an organised workshop under A standards rather than lettering practice and public criticism.
seedUse: Place-card seed supplies lettering interest and aunt objection; S03 adds specific baseline/consistency corrections without merely complimenting B.
